A simple class providing dynamic arbitrary-precision arithmetic.

detaileddescription.para: Internally, it stores an APInt, whose width is doubled whenever an overflow occurs at a certain width. The default constructor sets the initial width to 64. SlowDynamicAPInt is primarily intended to be used as a slow fallback path for the upcoming DynamicAPInt class.
